## P1.2 — Tree invariants

Every parent/destination is a live folder of the same storage, checked on rows locked inside the
transaction; a null destination is the storage root (no Action writes `parent_id = NULL`); the root is
never renamed, moved, copied, trashed or force-deleted; restore and force-delete accept only trashed
nodes, trashing twice is rejected; names go through `NodeName::normalize()`; a unique one-root-per-storage
index (`addSingleRootIndex`, generated `root_storage` column on MySQL/MariaDB) backs I1; migration №6
`2026_10_01_000006_nodes_cleanup` moves legacy second roots under the root (` (legacy N)` renames capped
at 255 bytes, `node.moved` activity with `reason = n04_repair`), is idempotent and refuses storages without
`root_node_id`. New: `InvalidDestinationException`, `NodeNotTrashedException`, `InvalidNodeNameException`,
`NodeName`, `TreeGuard` (internal), `NodeStoreRepository::lockForUpdate`, `NodeReadRepository::isRoot`,
`VaulterDatabase::lockTreeShared`.

## Concurrency — global lock matrix (deviation from Scope п.4 table)

The spec's per-action lock table did not guarantee freedom from cycles. The item follows
`lock-matrix.md`: every tree write takes the storage tree lock first — exclusive for move, restore,
trash, force-delete and purge; shared for create, upload (new file and new version), copy and rename —
then node rows (ascending, or strictly upward for rename), then `CAS`, then quota. Additions beyond the
table: tree lock in Trash, Create, Upload, Copy, Rename and `vaulter:purge-trash`; rename also locks the
parent; a new-version upload locks its target before `CAS` and measures the quota delta from the locked
row. Race reproduced and closed: trash of an ancestor ‖ create under a descendant left a live child under
a trashed folder (PG, 2/10 without the shared lock, 0/20 with it — `TreeLockRaceTest`).

## Other deviations

- `TreeGuard` lives in core: documents may not depend on drive (arch test). `CreateDocumentNodeAction`
  reports a foreign-storage parent as `InvalidDestinationException::otherDrive`; the document `parent = null`
  test lives in documents tests.
- Over HTTP a foreign-storage `parent_id` is 404 (existing controller scoping); the PHP API raises
  `CrossStorageMoveException` (rendered 409 `cross_drive_operation`).
- Restore has no destination input until P3.3: original parent if live folder, else root.
- Tests rewritten under the contract: forceDelete of live nodes (trash first), trash-twice order, second
  roots in `NodeSearchLikeEscapingTest`, soft-deleted root in the `StorageManager::root()` test (hard delete);
  `HostKeyColumnsMigrationTest` compares host-key columns only and rolls back the whole upgrade batch.
- `docs/guide/errors.md` gained the three anchors (required by `DocsDriftGuardTest`).

## Review (owner requirement: Grok 4.7 high, fresh, read-only)

Attempt 1 had no verdict (packet truncated, tools blocked by hooks; `incomplete-1-*`). Review 1
findings:4, recheck 1 findings:2, recheck 2 findings:1 — each round a new lock-order cycle, fixed locally;
recheck 3 was stopped as superseded when the design moved to the global matrix. Final matrix review
findings:4: #1 (new-version CAS before node lock — PG cycle) and #2 (purge locked the trashed root before
the tree lock) fixed; #3 fixed for lock order and deleted targets; its eager-quota race and #4 (copy reads
the source subtree without locks — copy quota is Scope Excluded) are deferred to PLAN2.P1.6. No GREEN verdict
was obtained; the plan's ≤2-round budget was exceeded and no further round was run at the owner's request
to stop spending. Verbatim verdicts: `review-1-findings.md`, `recheck-{1,2}-findings.md`,
`review-final-findings.md`.

## Residual risk

- PLAN2.P1.6: quota checks/deltas under D21 (new-version eager check, copy sizes) — see `lock-matrix.md`.
- `StorageManager::root()` re-provisioning fails on the single-root index if a parentless row survives
  without `root_node_id` (outside Files).
- MySQL/MariaDB paths (generated column, idempotent DDL, lock order) are code-reviewed, not executed here.
